definitions.explanation: A warm, pleasant feeling of longing for the past or for familiar things from one's memories.

examples.japanese: {故郷|ふるさと}の{風景|ふうけい}を{見|み}て{懐|なつ}かしさがこみ{上|あ}げてきた。
examples.english: Seeing the scenery of my hometown, nostalgia welled up inside me.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}を{聞|き}くと{懐|なつ}かしさを{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: When I hear this song, I feel nostalgic.

notes:
FORMATION:
⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧ (i-adjective) → {懐|なつ}かしさ (noun form)

BASE ADJECTIVE:
⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧ describes:
・Fond memories
・Things from the past that evoke warm feelings
・Familiar things one hasn't encountered in a while

USAGE:
{懐|なつ}かしさ is commonly used in:
・Descriptions of returning to familiar places
・Reactions to old photos, music, or memories
・Expressions of longing for the past

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{懐|なつ}かしさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こみ{上|あ}げる→込み上げる：10335_komiageru⟧ (nostalgia wells up)
・{懐|なつ}かしさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}る→浸る：13339_hitaru⟧ (to immerse oneself in nostalgia)
・{懐|なつ}かしさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel nostalgic)
・{懐|なつ}かしさ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{切|せつ}なさ→切なさ：06728_setsunasa⟧ (nostalgia and poignancy — often paired)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Nostalgia holds a special place in Japanese aesthetics. Words like {懐|なつ}かしさ connect to broader cultural concepts of appreciating the passage of time and cherishing memories.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦ノスタルジー→ノスタルジー：noentry⟧ - nostalgia (loanword)
・⟦{郷愁|きょうしゅう}→郷愁：06000_kyoushuu⟧ - homesickness, nostalgia (more literary)
